title: KaneMobs
description: Advanced mob control for Paper/Spigot: configurable damage per mob, scaling with armor, balanced Piglin system with custom drops, and villagers with stable trades.
body:
KaneMobs

KaneMobs is an advanced mob control and balancing system designed for modern Paper-based Minecraft servers.

The plugin completely reworks vanilla survival mechanics, giving server owners full control over mob damage, armor scaling, villager behavior, Piglin bartering, and overall gameplay balance — creating a fairer, more challenging, and exploit-free survival experience.

⚔️ Intelligent Damage System
 - Per-mob, per-world, and per-attack-type configuration
 - MULTIPLY, ADD, and SET damage modes
 - Advanced scaling for enchanted armor (Protection support)
 - Support for special attacks (example: Warden Sonic Boom)
 - Built for Hardcore and RPG balancing

🛡️ Armor Scaling System
 - KaneMobs dynamically increases survival difficulty depending on the player's gear.

Features:
 - Diamond and Netherite armor scaling
 - Full Protection enchantment support
 - Full armor set bonuses
 - Mixed armor support
 - Configurable maximum scaling limits
- 
Example:
 - Players wearing full Netherite Protection IV armor can receive significantly increased mob damage, preventing late-game survival from becoming too easy.

🧑 Optimized Villagers

>- KaneMobs improves villager trading behavior while preserving vanilla gameplay feel.

Features:
 - Prevents common villager reroll exploits
 - XP stabilization system
 - Maintains vanilla professions and trade behavior
 - Lightweight and fully configurable
 
🐷 Reworked Piglin Bartering System
The vanilla Piglin barter system has been completely redesigned.

Features:
 - Removes broken vanilla RNG behavior
 - Only 1 reward item per barter
 - Fully configurable drops via drops.yml
 - Configurable chances, amounts, delays, and cooldowns
 - Optional override of vanilla Piglin rewards
 - Advanced weighted drop system
 - Better economy balancing for Survival servers
🔗 KaneEnchants Integration

 - KaneMobs now supports direct integration with KaneEnchants.

Features:
 - Equipped mobs can spawn with custom enchantments
 - Supports weapons, armor, bows, and crossbows
 - Piglins can barter enchanted items and books
 - Smart compatibility system
 - Fully configurable chances and enchantment pools
 - Automatic hook system using softdepend
  - 🗄️ Optional MySQL Integration

Includes optional asynchronous MySQL support for advanced servers.

 - Logging Support:
 - Mob damage activity
 - Villager interactions
 - Piglin barter activity

 - Designed to avoid TPS impact through asynchronous database operations.

⚙️ Advanced Configuration System

 - KaneMobs was built with a KanePc-style configuration philosophy.

Features:
 - Fully configurable YAML files
 - config.yml
 - drops.yml
 - Advanced debug system
 - Runtime toggles
 - Protected admin commands and permissions

🔒 Permissions
 - kanemobs.admin
 - kanemobs.reload
 - kanemobs.toggle
 - kanemobs.mysql
- 
⌨️ Commands
 - /kanemobs
 - /km
 - Available Subcommands:
 - reload
 - toggle
 - mysql test

🌍 Supported Versions
 - Minecraft Versions:
 - 1.21+
 - Fully tested on Paper 1.21.8 / 26.1.2
 
Supported Server Software:
  ✔ Paper
  ✔ Purpur
  ✔ Pufferfish
  ⚠ Spigot (experimental support)

Recommended:
  Paper 1.21.8 (26.1.2)
  Java 21
🚀 Designed For Paper

KaneMobs is ideal for:

> Survival Servers
> Hardcore Servers
> Economy Servers
> RPG Servers
> Custom Progression Servers

> Perfect for server owners who want full control over mob behavior, survival difficulty, and gameplay balance.

💡 Summary

>KaneMobs transforms Minecraft survival into a more balanced, scalable, and professional experience — without losing the vanilla feeling.
